newsitem.title: UK: Report on threatened French refineries delayed-Shell.
newsitem.headline: Report on threatened French refineries delayed-Shell.

text.p: An oil industry report to the French government outlining a proposed solution for excess refining capacity in southern France has been postponed, Royal Dutch/Shell Group said on Tuesday.
"The target date of January 31 is going to slip," a Shell spokesman said.
Shell operates a refinery at Berre l'Etang, one of four refineries around the French Mediterranean port of Marseilles.
The company said in December it was in talks with its three competitors in the region, Esso France, Total and BP France on plans to cooperate in reducing capacity.
"Negotations are continuing and no new date has been set for the report to the industy ministry," said the Shell spokesman.
European refiners last year announced closures, mergers or cutbacks at plants in Switzerland, Denmark, Germany, Britain and the Netherlands after profit margins slumped in 1995.
